caveats: The controlled baseline changes the cape and spell-flight runtime files; it includes the GDScript cape descriptor cache and both native kernels as one combined candidate.
Four-mode screen results are sequential one-process diagnostics and are order-sensitive.
Headless reversal medians combine run means only; per-run tails remain attached to each process.
Window wall time is compositor paced and non-authoritative; renderer counters are diagnostic asynchronous samples.
The attribution run includes observer/timer overhead and is excluded from acceptance aggregation.
The first Compatibility candidate maximum exceeded the single baseline maximum; tails do not uniformly improve.

Visual inspection of eight representative baseline/candidate active and settled Compatibility/Forward+ captures found no missing equipped actors, capes, labels, or effects; phase differences prevent a pixel-identity claim.
Forward+ showed brighter grass and paler spells than Compatibility for both variants; Compatibility remains the default, and Forward+ art direction needs broader visual QA.
